reason: The submitted CIFs are valid primitive Z=3 AlGeMo enantiomorphs (nine fully occupied atoms; P3_212/P3_112; a=4.849549 A, c=6.731524 A), index all important reflections, give an instantiated whole-profile fit close to a free-intensity bound, and have plausible complete neighbor shells with a 2.629 A minimum contact. However, the trace did not test or submit the concrete Ge/Mo interchange between the x~0.166 and x~0.500 threefold orbits. Refining that ordered P3_212 realization in memory preserves the same cell, stoichiometry, symmetry, and sound distances, yet gives whole-profile RMS 0.131044 versus 0.131002 for selected.cif (normalized residual 0.039223 versus 0.039210); the two calculated profiles differ by only 0.00137 RMS, far below the measured off-peak noise of 0.104. This is a materially different, diffraction-compatible element ordering not quantitatively excluded strongly enough and absent from the submitted set.
